question.problem:
What is the value of $7$ raised to the power of $3?$

$7$ raised to the power of $3$ is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
We need to evaluate ${7}^{3}.$

To evaluate ${7}^{3},$ we start by writing it out with multiplication signs:

$$
{7}^{3}={{7\times 7\times 7}_{⏟}}_{3\text{ times}}
$$

Now, we compute the product. Since $7\times 7=49,$ we have

$$
{{7\times 7}_{⏟}}_{49}\times 7=49\times 7.
$$

Finally, we work out $49\times 7.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\,{}_{6}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,9\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, &  &  & \,\,\,\,7\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\,\end{aligned} \\  & \end{aligned}
$$

Since $49\times 7=343,$ we have ${7}^{3}=343.$
